unresolved_findings.finding: The original canonical URL remains unavailable. Replacement source and license are newly observed and cannot establish the historical source contents or license.
Replacement README gives example package versions without an installation recipe or dependency lock; a substantially specified environment/use path is absent.
Training imports neu_op, but the replacement tree supplies neuop.py; the model import does not resolve as written.
Datasets and pretrained files are external and unvalidated; the training path is an author-specific absolute path requiring adaptation.
The advertised CPU branch writes to a previously closed file handle because only the CUDA branch reopens it.
Final save uses a root-relative path on POSIX and reuses the last periodic checkpoint state, omitting later training updates and optimizer state.
README checkpoint name ends epoch800.pt while the test notebook loads epoch80.pt.
NumPy window sampling is seeded, but model/loader randomness and actual hardware are not specified.
Masked relative loss lacks empty-mask/zero-norm guards, and no verified rerun acceptance threshold is established.
